title: Apexspace header
description: A 65px sticky bar that starts transparent over the hero and fills with the page colour after about 400px of scroll. Wordmark left; on wide screens a row of numbered mono nav cells ("1.0 LABEL +") split by full-height hairlines, ending in a call-to-action cell with an arrow; the dim numbers and icons brighten on hover. Phones get a three-line menu button and a full-screen numbered menu.
notes: sticky with a −65px bottom margin: the next section slides under it, so give that section 65px of room at its top (apexspace-hero does)
the background fade is a CSS scroll timeline on the page; browsers without it (and reduced motion) show the filled bar
needs JavaScript (hydrate: load) for the phone menu
the desktop row shows from 1280px; below that the menu button
